data.group: Heretic Astartes Daemon Prince with Wings
data.summary: Each time this model finishes a Charge move, choose an enemy unit within its Engagement Range and roll a D6 for each wound this model has left. Every 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that unit, up to 6 mortal wounds in total.
